result.instructions: Tools for Ascora, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which quotes have been sent to customers but not yet accepted?"; "Show me the jobs that are completed but not yet invoiced."; "Who is booked on the schedule next week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ascora data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ascora_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ascora_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ascora_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ascora_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ascora_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Search Ascora customers (sites and billing customers): id, number, name, contact, email, phone, addresses, on-hold flags, customer type, lead source, billing customer and assigned user. GET /Customers/Customers.

filter_text.description: Free text across customer number, email, phone, mobile, billing customer name and contact names.

phone_number.description: Searches the phone and mobile fields.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

site_billing_type.description: Which kind of customer to return (default All).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One Ascora customer by id (GUID from ascora_list_customers), including custom fields. GET /Customers/Customer/{id}.

tools.name: ascora_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search contacts across all customers by name, email or phone. GET /Customers/Contacts.

filter_text.description: Contains-match on first name, last name, email, phone or mobile.

phone_number.description: Exact match on phone or mobile (spaces ignored).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_customer_contacts
tools.title: List contacts of a customer
tools.description: All contacts of one customer, with role and default-contact flag. GET /Customers/GetContactsForCustomer/{customerId}.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_supplies
tools.title: List supplies (price list)
tools.description: Search the inventory price list: materials and services with part number, description, cost, sell price ex/inc tax, supplier, categories and reorder flags. Use the supply id to add items to quotes. GET /Inventory/Supplies.

filter_text.description: Searches part number, supplier part number, description, annotation and category name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_kits
tools.title: List kits
tools.description: Search kits (bundles of supplies and labour) with part number, description, markup, sell price and pricing method. GET /Inventory/Kits.

filter_text.description: Searches part number, supplier part number, description, annotation and category name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_categories
tools.title: List inventory categories
tools.description: Inventory categories (Category 1 or 2, top-level or sub-categories) used to filter supplies and kits. GET /Inventory/Categories.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_labour_roles
tools.title: List labour roles
tools.description: Labour roles with their hourly rate ex tax, ordered by name. Use the role id to add labour to a quote. GET /Quotes/LabourRoles.

tools.name: ascora_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: Search quotes: number, name, status, date, totals ex/inc tax, pricing method, job type and site/billing customer. Status defaults to OPEN (in progress or sent) when omitted. GET /Quotes/Quotes.

filter_text.description: Partial match on quote number, name or address.

quote_status.description: Status filter; OPEN (default) = in progress or sent to customer, WON = converted to jobs, ACCEPTED = accepted but not yet converted, ALL = every quote.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

customer_name.description: Partial match on site or billing customer name.

start_date.description: Quotes created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Quotes created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_get_quote
tools.title: Get quote
tools.description: One quote by its full number (e.g. Q57): status, dates, totals, pricing method, addresses, job type, customers and custom fields. GET /Quotes/Quote/{quoteNumber}.

quote_number.description: Full Quote Number, e.g. Q57. A section is Q1234.01 (or Q1234-01).

tools.name: ascora_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: Search jobs: number, name, status, totals, pricing method, job type, site/billing customer, secondary status and pipeline phase. Status defaults to OPEN when omitted. GET /Jobs/Jobs.

filter_text.description: Partial match on job number, name or address.

job_status.description: Status filter (default open jobs). COMPLETED-NOT-INVOICED and READY-TO-INVOICE find work not yet billed; ALL = every job.

assigned_user.description: Full name of the assigned user.

customer_name.description: Partial match on site or billing customer name.

include_child_jobs.description: Also return the sections and stages inside jobs.

start_date.description: Jobs created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: Jobs created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by its full number (e.g. J112): status, dates, totals, pricing method, job type, customers, secondary status and pipeline phase. A deleted job reads as not found. GET /Jobs/Job/{jobNumber}.

job_number.description: Full Job Number, e.g. J112. A section or stage is J1234.01 (or J1234-01).

tools.name: ascora_get_job_labour
tools.title: Get job labour
tools.description: Labour lines on a job: role, hours, hourly rate, totals, staff member, chargeable and invoiced flags. GET /Jobs/JobLabour/{jobNumber}.

job_number.description: Full Job Number, e.g. J112. A section or stage is J1234.01 (or J1234-01).

tools.name: ascora_get_job_timesheets
tools.title: Get job timesheets
tools.description: Timesheet entries on a job: staff member, start/end, hours, meal break and payroll-sent flag (pay and cost rates are not returned). GET /Jobs/JobTimesheets/{jobNumber}.

job_number.description: Full Job Number, e.g. J112. A section or stage is J1234.01 (or J1234-01).

tools.name: ascora_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings (schedule)
tools.description: Search the schedule: bookings of jobs, quotes and activities with staff member, start/end, notes, arrival window and the job or quote they belong to. Archived bookings are excluded unless include_archived. GET /Bookings/Bookings.

start_date.description: Bookings overlapping this period start (yyyy-mm-dd covers the whole day).

modified_since.description: Bookings created, changed or archived at or after this date-time (ISO 8601).

job_number.description: Bookings of this job (sections and stages included).

customer_id.description: Bookings whose job or quote has this site customer.

customer_name.description: Partial match on site or billing customer name.

user.description: One staff member, by id, full name, email or login.

team_name.description: Bookings of the members of this team.

job_status.description: Comma-separated job statuses, e.g. BOOKED,IN-PROGRESS (also ALL-OPEN, COMPLETED, CLOSED, CANCELLED).

quote_status.description: Comma-separated quote statuses, e.g. IN-PROGRESS,SENT-TO-CUSTOMER (also OPEN, WON, LOST).

filter_text.description: Partial match on job or quote number, name, address, site customer, activity title and notes.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: One booking by id: type, times (local and UTC), staff member, job/quote/activity, customers, address, notes, arrival window, rates and reminder flags. GET /Bookings/Booking/{bookingId}.

tools.name: ascora_list_activity_types
tools.title: List activity types
tools.description: Activity types that non-job bookings (training, leave-style activities, etc.) can be made with. GET /Bookings/ActivityTypes.

tools.name: ascora_list_users
tools.title: List staff users
tools.description: Staff users of the Ascora company (archived users excluded): id, name, email, mobile, job title, team, scheduler group, licence and access flags. Pay rates are not returned. GET /Users/Users.

scheduler_group_name.description: Only members of this scheduler group.

filter_text.description: Contains-match on first name, last name, email and login.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: Search suppliers by name, supplier number or exact business number (ABN). GET /Suppliers/Suppliers.

business_number.description: Exact match on the business number (e.g. ABN), spaces ignored.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_list_supplier_invoices
tools.title: List supplier invoices
tools.description: Search supplier invoices and credit notes: supplier, dates, tracking number, lines and totals. GET /SupplierInvoices/SupplierInvoices.

tracking_number.description: Partial match on the supplier invoice or credit note number.

to_be_sent_to_accounting.description: Only invoices not yet pushed to the accounting package.

invoice_date_start.description: Invoice date on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

invoice_date_end.description: Invoice date on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: ascora_create_enquiry
tools.title: Create enquiry (lead)
tools.description: WRITE: create a new enquiry (lead) in Ascora. Every call creates another enquiry (not idempotent; Ascora allows 500 enquiries an hour per company), so do not repeat it. Needs at least a name, company, email, phone or mobile. POST /Enquiry.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values. The field definitions must already exist in Ascora.

name.description: Custom field name exactly as entered in Ascora (Administration -> Custom Fields).

tools.name: ascora_create_customer
tools.title: Create customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (site or billing) in Ascora. Always creates a new record (it never updates an existing customer), so search with ascora_list_customers first to avoid duplicates. A customer type or lead source name that does not exist is created. POST /Customers/Customer.

company_name.description: Company name; for an individual leave empty and give first and last name.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values. The field definitions must already exist in Ascora.

name.description: Custom field name exactly as entered in Ascora (Administration -> Custom Fields).

tools.name: ascora_add_note
tools.title: Add note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to an enquiry, job, quote, invoice or customer (the entity must already exist). Notes cannot be edited or removed through this server, and every call adds another note. POST /Notes/Note.

entity_type.description: What the note is attached to.

entity_id.description: Id (GUID) of the enquiry, job, quote, invoice or customer.

created_by_name.description: Name shown as the author (default 'AI assistant').

tools.name: ascora_create_quote
tools.title: Create quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a new quote (status In Progress; it is NOT sent to the customer) for a site customer, optionally with supplies, kits and labour from the price list. Ids that Ascora cannot find are skipped silently when creating, so check the totals in the reply. Every call creates another quote. POST /Quotes/Quote.

site_customer_id.description: Site customer id (from ascora_list_customers). Give this or site_customer_name.

site_customer_name.description: Exact customer name if you have no id.

billing_customer_id.description: Billing customer id; defaults to the site's billing customer.

job_type_name.description: Job type name; default job type when empty.

supplies.description: Supplies from ascora_list_supplies (not for SECTIONS or STAGES pricing).

labour.description: Labour roles from ascora_list_labour_roles; quantity = hours.

tools.name: ascora_update_quote_status
tools.title: Update quote status
tools.description: WRITE: change a quote's status to IN-PROGRESS, SENT-TO-CUSTOMER, LOST or WON. WON converts the quote into a new Job (the same as ascora_convert_quote_to_job; a second WON returns the existing job). Ascora's reference documents only a status change, not an email to the customer. POST /Quotes/UpdateStatus.

quote_number.description: Full Quote Number, e.g. Q57. A section is Q1234.01 (or Q1234-01).

reason_for_loss.description: Recorded as the reason for loss when status is LOST.

tools.name: ascora_convert_quote_to_job
tools.title: Convert quote to job
tools.description: WRITE: convert a quote into a Job (what Convert to Job does in Ascora): supplies, labour, notes, bookings and attachments carry over and the quote is marked converted. Never forces a new job: a variation quote is added onto its original job, a quote whose job still exists is reconnected to it, and a quote already converted is refused with a message naming the existing job. Specify the parent quote number, not a section. POST /Quotes/ConvertToJob.

quote_number.description: Full Quote Number, e.g. Q57. A section is Q1234.01 (or Q1234-01).

tools.name: ascora_create_job
tools.title: Create job
tools.description: WRITE: create a new job for a site customer (it never updates an existing job). Every call creates another job; add work with a quote or in Ascora. The job is not booked and nothing is sent to the customer. POST /Jobs/Job.

site_customer_id.description: Site customer id (from ascora_list_customers). Give this or site_customer_name.

site_customer_name.description: Exact customer name if you have no id.

billing_customer_id.description: Billing customer id; defaults to the site's billing customer.

job_type_name.description: Job type name; default job type when empty.

pricing_method.description: Default pricing method of the company when empty.

tools.name: ascora_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: schedule staff on a job or a quote (give exactly one of job_number / quote_number). One booking is created per staff member and the job or quote moves to Booked; the bookings show on the Scheduler and the staff mobile apps, and Ascora's own reminder settings may notify the customer or staff. Repeating the identical request returns the existing booking. By default a clash with another booking or leave refuses the whole request (reject_conflicts). POST /Bookings/Booking.

job_number.description: Full Job Number to book, e.g. J1234 or J1234.01.

users.description: Staff to book: each a user id (GUID from ascora_list_users) or a full name, email or login.

start_time.description: Start, e.g. 2026-10-06T08:00:00 (company local time unless you add Z or an offset).

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes; give this or end_time.

time_window.description: Arrival window shown to the customer, e.g. 8am - 10am.

reject_conflicts.description: Refuse the request when a staff member is already booked or on leave then (default true here; false books anyway and lists the clashes).

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Ascora
prompts.description: What you can do with Ascora here, with example requests to try.
